08. SHADER LOGIC (PSEUDO-CODE)

float

scan = sin(_Time.y * SCAN_SPEED);

float

pulse = smoothstep(0.2, 0.8, abs(sin(_Time.y * PULSE_SPEED)));

float

noise = tex3D(_NoiseTex, uv * NOISE_SCALE + _Time.y).r;

float

iris = length(uv - 0.5);

float

ring = smoothstep(IRIS_INNER, IRIS_OUTER, iris);

float

glitch = step(0.995, noise) * rand(uv + _Time.y);

float

intensity = (1.0 - ring) * (0.6 + pulse * 0.4);

float

scanLine = step(frac(uv.y * SCAN_DENSITY + scan), 0.02);

float

color = lerp(COLOR_BASE, COLOR_HIGHLIGHT, intensity);

color

+= scanLine * COLOR_SCAN;

color

+= glitch * COLOR_GLITCH;

return

float4(color, 1.0);
